subject.title: Feature Request: Custom TUI Footer Fields for Cost/Balance/Rate Limit Status

question: Should persistent TUI footer customization be a core config template, a PluginStatusProvider-style SDK seam with TUI rendering, or remain limited to `/usage` and `/status` surfaces?
rationale: The code has partial usage and provider-status data, but choosing where persistent footer contributions live changes public config, Plugin SDK surface, provider credential behavior, and TUI rendering policy.

options.title: Plugin/API-first footer seam
options.body: Accept a narrow plugin status-provider contract plus a TUI render follow-up, with provider cost/balance/quota data supplied through bounded provider-usage or plugin contributions.

options.title: Core TUI template config
options.body: Add a `tui` footer template/config surface directly in core, accepting the compatibility and provider-polling policy burden.

options.title: Keep existing surfaces only
options.body: Leave persistent TUI footer fixed and route quota/cost observability to `/usage`, `/status`, CLI, and platform-specific surfaces.

recommendation.title: Plugin/API-first footer seam
recommendation.body: Accept a narrow plugin status-provider contract plus a TUI render follow-up, with provider cost/balance/quota data supplied through bounded provider-usage or plugin contributions.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is the strongest history owner for provider usage, usage footers, and usage cost reporting, which are the core data surfaces this decision would compose.
